title: TailnetCertVerifier delegates TLS handshake signature verification to provider
description: verify_tls12_signature and verify_tls13_signature both delegate to rustls::crypto::verify_tls1{2,3}_signature. Cert chain trust is skipped (Tailscale authenticates at the network layer), but the cryptographic handshake is still fully verified, preserving confidentiality against on-path attackers. A contributor might ask 'if we skip cert validation, why not skip signature verification?' — the answer is these are orthogonal properties.
